other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and / or a fine.

The maximum penalty depends on the maximum term for summary offences, see section 1(7) of the Animal Welfare (Livestock Exports) Act 2024 ; for offences committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, this is 6 months, for offences committed after that time 51 weeks.Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
